The heat from the spice allows you to enjoy the large portion of the meat's savoriness.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Meat Curries are [[Meal]]s made by [[Cooking]] [[Raw Meat]], [[Hylian Rice]], and [[Goron Spice]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. They can be eaten to restore some of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]]. The heat from the Goron Spice allows one to enjoy the savoriness of the [[Meat]]. By adding more [[Ingredient]]s to Meat Curry, several different variations can be made: * '''Chilly Meat Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Meat Curry}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
The heat from the spice allows you to enjoy the large portion of the meat's savoriness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding cold Ingredients. Link will be granted one level of [[Heat Resistance]] if he eats these curries. * '''Electro Meat Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Meat Curry}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
The heat from the spice allows you to enjoy the large portion of the meat's savoriness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding electric Ingredients. Link gains one level of [[Shock Resistance]] when he eats these curries. * '''Enduring Meat Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Meat Curry}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
The heat from the spice allows you to enjoy the large portion of the meat's savoriness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding enduring Ingredients. Eating these curries will completely refill and overfill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Energizing Meat Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Meat Curry}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
The heat from the spice allows you to enjoy the large portion of the meat's savoriness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding energizing Ingredients. They replenish a portion of Link's Stamina Wheel when consumed. * '''Hasty Meat Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Meat Curry}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
The heat from the spice allows you to enjoy the large portion of the meat's savoriness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hasty Ingredients. If eaten, they'll increase Link's movement speed. * '''Hearty Meat Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Meat Curry}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
The heat from the spice allows you to enjoy the large portion of the meat's savoriness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hearty Ingredients. When eaten, they'll heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him [[Extra Hearts]]. * '''Mighty Meat Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Meat Curry}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
The heat from the spice allows you to enjoy the large portion of the meat's savoriness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding mighty Ingredients. They offer Link a boost to his attack power when consumed. * '''Sneaky Meat Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Meat Curry}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
The heat from the spice allows you to enjoy the large portion of the meat's savoriness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding sneaky Ingredients. When eaten, they increase Link's [[Stealth]] for a short period of time. * '''Spicy Meat Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Meat Curry}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
The heat from the spice allows you to enjoy the large portion of the meat's savoriness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding spicy Ingredients. When eaten, Link will gain one temporary level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Tough Meat Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Meat Curry}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
The heat from the spice allows you to enjoy the large portion of the meat's savoriness.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding tough Ingredients. They can be eaten to temporarily increase Link's [[Defense]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Gourmet Meat Curry * Meal * Prime Meat Curry }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Curries, Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK }}
